2014_spells.infernal-calling.effectSumma: The devil disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends
2014_spells.infernal-calling.fullDescrip: Using 1 minute, the devil disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. Roll initiative for the devil, which has its own turns; A devil of challenge rating 6 or lower appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The devil disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
